newsitem.title: USA: Pakistan seeks 360,000 T US/Australia wheat-agent.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan seeks 360,000 T US/Australia wheat-agent.

text.p: Pakisan will hold side-by-side tenders for 360,000 tonnes of U.S. soft white wheat and Australian white milling wheat, the country's shipping agent said on Monday.
Bids for both tenders will be opened on February 16 and must be valid the following day on February 17.
Shipment for both tenders was slated for March 5-31.
The U.S. No 2 or better soft white wheat was in bulk plus or minus five percent, buyer's option, under the U.S. Department of Agriculture's GSM-102 export credit guarantee program, the agent said.
